name: github-repo-cleaner
description: A free, English-first GitHub cleanup website and self-contained browser workspace. No subscriptions or application backend.

scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm install --no-save playwright && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium && node --test test/browser.test.mjs
scripts.deploy:check: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy --dry-run
